rows.jp: よーし、任せとけ！
rows.en: All right! I’ve got this!

ghs.en: Ohhh yeah, leave this to me!

rows.jp: 「先輩」
rows.en: “Misato.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Senpai."

rows.en: “...Yeees?”

ghs.en: Misato: "...wha-at?"

rows.jp: 「俺と結婚してくださいよ！」
rows.en: “Marry me!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Please marry me!"

rows.jp: 親指を立てて告った。
rows.en: I popped the question with a big thumbs-up.

ghs.en: So I proclaim with a raised thumb.

rows.jp: 「うふ」
rows.en: “Teehee.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Eheh..."

rows.jp: 先輩はまるで天使のように柔らかく微笑んだ。
rows.en: Misato smiled as softly as an angel.

ghs.en: Senpai gave a smile of softness so like an angel's.

rows.en: ＊・゜゜・AN ANGEL † DESCENDS・゜゜・＊

rows.jp: 「絶対いやです♪」
rows.en: “Absolutely not♪”

ghs.en: Misato: "Absolutely never!♪"

rows.jp: 「もしもし友貴？　黒須だけど。うん、今おまえのねーちゃんに告って振られたトコ。マジマジ、ライブ。だってまだ隣にいるもん。ブヒャヒャヒャヒャ！」
rows.en: “Hello, Tomoki? Kurosu here. Yeah, I just proposed to your sister and got shot down. No, seriously—live. She’s still right next to me. BWAHAHAHA!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hello, Tomoki? It's just Kurosu. I've just now confessed and been shot down by your nee-chan. Serious, I'm serious, live reporting. She's still right next to me! Hyeeh hyeh hyeh hyeh hyeh!"

rows.jp: 「とにかくさとにかくさ、俺の胸中、苦い喜びで満ちみちてＮＯＷ。おまえに後押しされて気持ち伝えてみてサイコー良かった！！　死にくされや！！」
rows.en: “Anyway, anyway—my heart is overflowing with bittersweet joy as we speak. You pushed me to confess, and I’m so damn glad I did! Rot in hell!!”

ghs.en: "Anywayingly anyway, depths of chest filledy full of bitter delight nau. And I'm sooo grateful for you supporting me in trying to convey my feelings!!! Rot & die!!!"

rows.jp: 「その携帯……電池切れてませんか？」
rows.en: “Your phone... The battery’s dead, isn’t it?”

ghs.en: Misato: "That cellphone... did not the battery run out?"

rows.jp: 「わかってますよそんなこと！」
rows.en: “I know that!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I know that, damn it all!"

rows.jp: 泣き伏す。
rows.en: I crumpled, sobbing.

ghs.en: I break down in tears.

rows.jp: 「うおーん！」
rows.en: “Waaaaah!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Bwoooh!"

rows.jp: 「彼に当たらずとも……」
rows.en: “There’s no need to take it out on him...”

ghs.en: Misato: "He was close but..."

rows.jp: 「冗談のつもりって自覚していながらもしかしたらいい感じになるかなって都合の良い期待はそりゃもう明確にありましたからキッパリ断られるとそれはそれで胸が痛いんですジャア！」
rows.en: “I knew it was a joke, but of course some selfish little part of me hoped it might work, so getting shot down still hurts like hell, BROTHER!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Despite being aware that the intent was jocular I wondered maybe could it possibly be that this will end up happily but my so convenient expectations were so very transparent and therefore plainly turned down and that is the cause for the pain in my heart, Hulk Hogan!"

rows.jp: 「絶対拒絶されるタイミングで告る方に問題があるんジャア……」
rows.en: “The problem is confessing at the one moment you knew you’d be rejected, BROTHER...”

ghs.en: Misato: "But the problem lies in how you confessed with the exact timing for an absolute rejection, Hulk Hogan..."

rows.jp: 「人生、一寸先は闇なんジャア！　今を信じるしかないんジャア！」
rows.en: “You never know what’s waiting around the next corner, BROTHER! All you can do is believe in the here and now, BROTHER!”

ghs.en:
Taichi: "LIFE HAS DARKNESS JUST ONE STEP AHEAD!!!
WHAT THE FUTURE HOLDS NO ONE KNOWS!!!
ONLY IN THE PRESENT CAN ONE CONFIDE, HULKHOGAAAN!!!"

rows.jp: 「ほら、キュウリの酢漬けあげますから、元気を出して。そしてレスラー口調はもうよしましょう。ね？」
rows.en: “Here, have a pickle and cheer up. And let’s drop the pro-wrestler voices now, all right?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Come now, I will give you some cucumbers with pickles, so cheer up! Also, let us stop talking like that wrestler. OK?"

rows.jp: 「お、俺の愛はキュウリで賄えてしまうとですか……」
rows.en: “M-my love is only worth one pickle...?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Th-, the price of my love can be covered by a cucumber..."

rows.jp: 「ぺけくんにはもっと素敵な想い人ができますよ、きっと」
rows.en: “You’ll find someone even more wonderful to love someday, Peke. I’m sure of it.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Peke-kun, you will find a much more wonderful lover than me, I am sure."

rows.jp: 「泣きそう」
rows.en: “I’m gonna cry.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's to cry."

rows.jp: キュウリは失恋の味がした。
rows.en: The pickle tasted like heartbreak.

ghs.en: The cucumber had the taste of a broken heart.
